d: Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.

People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

Ready to redefine the art of marketing? Bring your passion to turn strategies into experiences and campaigns into celebrations. Join a team that cherishes your creativity and drive, thriving on making every moment truly matter.

Our people are at the core of our success. Your role guarantees variety and excitement every day. At RHG, we cherish your entrepreneurial spirit, collaborative nature. We are currently seeking a Marketing Executive to join our vibrant team. At RHG, we are in search of individuals who go beyond the resume – those with character, skills, talents, and a passion for creating memorable experiences. We value mindset as pivotal: anticipating guest needs, supporting your department, and consistently delivering memorable experiences.
We are dedicated to nurturing and growing talent, offering pathways for advancement, and fostering a culture of continuous learning.

As a Marketing Executive, you infuse our dynamic Marketing Team with a blend of creativity, strategic thinking, and a relentless commitment to delivering impactful campaigns. Your role is a creative weapon, armed with innovative ideas, a results-driven approach, and a genuine passion for crafting compelling narratives that resonate with our audience.

d: We’re looking for a passionate, creative and results-driven Sr. Specialist Marcom to support the marketing strategy and growth campaign development for Qatar. In this role, you will be responsible for planning & developing marketing campaigns that drive customer acquisitions and improve customer retention. You will also be leading the execution and go-to-market of 360-degree campaigns as well as targeted CRM promotions.
Handles the execution of the 360 brand campaigns and ensures that all the required teams are fully aligned on all the deliverables to be done to meet deadlines.
Responsible for polishing the brand image in its different angles through communication: Riders, Brand tone, brand offering and character... etc

Facilitating & ensuring proper execution of all the campaign requirements, while continuously monitoring the campaign performance & exposure. Also, must take the necessary steps to ensure the campaign reaches the maximum exposure and performance while its running.
Handles media planning of all 360 campaigns to ensure balanced exposure with high impact to achieve the campaign objective.
Maintains constant taps on brand KPIs and sets the strategy/next steps to maintain them all on high scoring levels.
Ensures timely post campaign performance reports are with the marketing manager, enclosed with proper readings, strategy and next steps.
Ensure there’s a good inventory of giveaways and branding material for vendors and marketing activations.
Supporting with the planning of all CSR/PR related communication material.
Supervise the brand responses on social media & ensure all inquiries and complaints are attended to by the addressable teams in a timely manner.
Sets up a brainstorming session to continuously share engaging content that reflects the brand image and character.
Supervises the Social media coordinator and ensures that all his/her outputs match the quality standards when it comes to social media moderation, content creation and briefings.
Is the secondary POC for Macro influencers and handles the major complaints and feedback that is received with the required teams.
Weekly social media monitoring of the competitors’ & the brand’s performance.
Planning all brand-related performance marketing campaigns and submitting briefs in a timely manner to ensure smooth operations.

Handles the on-ground activations with all the hired suppliers to ensure everything is delivered as agreed with the marketing manager, handles the invitation management (prepares, delivers and secures RSVP), prepares event branding and set up, prepares and sets up the giveaways and supports the overall event agenda.
Continuously keeps the taps on important local events to push on brand presence during the important ones.
Takes charge of event branding and communication whenever an event is planned.
Responsible for double-checking the price offers shared by the vendors to control cost and quality.
Responsible for ensuring proper financial documentation of invoices, PQs and supporting reports received.
